commands: set -euo pipefail; adb start-server >/dev/null; test "$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {c++} END{print c+0}')" = '1'; MODEL=$(adb shell getprop ro.product.model | tr -d '\r'); echo DEVICE_MODEL=$MODEL; case "$MODEL" in SM-S906*) ;; *) echo UNEXPECTED_DEVICE_MODEL >&2; exit 20;; esac; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 2; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; adb shell monkey -p io.blueeye -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1 >/tmp/tracker-v3-monkey.txt 2>&1 || { cat /tmp/tracker-v3-monkey.txt; exit 21; }; sleep 3; if ! adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; then adb shell input tap 503 159; sleep 6; fi; PID=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID"; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$D/tracker_database-shm" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-shm"; sqlite3 "$D/tracker_database" 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples;'; }; C1=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-on1 | tail -n1); sleep 10; C2=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-on2 | tail -n1); echo SCREEN_ON_COUNTS=$C1,$C2; test "$C2" -gt "$C1" || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_NO_SCREEN_ON_RF_GROWTH >&2; exit 31; }; echo SCREEN_ON_RF_GROWTH_PASS

set -euo pipefail; snapshot_count(){ D="$1"; rm -rf "$D"; mkdir -p "$D"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database > "$D/tracker_database"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-wal > "$D/tracker_database-wal" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-wal"; adb exec-out run-as io.blueeye cat databases/tracker_database-shm > "$D/tracker_database-shm" 2>/dev/null || rm -f "$D/tracker_database-shm"; sqlite3 "$D/tracker_database" 'SELECT COUNT(*) FROM signal_samples;'; }; adb logcat -c; BEFORE=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-off-before | tail -n1); PID_BEFORE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test -n "$PID_BEFORE"; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_SLEEP; sleep 5; P1=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo POWER_AFTER_5S="$P1"; echo "$P1" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF' || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_PHONE_NOT_ASLEEP >&2; exit 40; }; sleep 45; P2=$(adb shell dumpsys power | grep -E 'mWakefulness=|Display Power: state=' | head -n 10 || true); echo POWER_AFTER_50S="$P2"; echo "$P2" | grep -Eq 'mWakefulness=(Asleep|Dozing)|Display Power: state=OFF' || { echo INCONCLUSIVE_PHONE_WOKE_DURING_TEST >&2; exit 41; }; PID_OFF=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_OFF" = "$PID_BEFORE" || { echo PROCESS_CHANGED_DURING_SCREEN_OFF >&2; exit 42; }; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'ScannerService'; adb shell dumpsys activity services io.blueeye | grep -q 'isForeground=true'; AFTER=$(snapshot_count /tmp/tracker-v3-off-after | tail -n1); echo SCREEN_OFF_COUNTS=$BEFORE,$AFTER; test "$AFTER" -gt "$BEFORE" || { echo SCREEN_OFF_SAMPLE_GROWTH_FAIL >&2; exit 43; }; echo SCREEN_OFF_SAMPLE_GROWTH_PASS; adb shell input keyevent KEYCODE_WAKEUP; sleep 3; adb shell wm dismiss-keyguard >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; PID_WAKE=$(adb shell pidof io.blueeye | tr -d '\r'); test "$PID_WAKE" = "$PID_BEFORE"; LOGS=$(adb logcat -d -v brief); echo '--- BLE_MODE_LOGS ---'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -E 'Switching passive BLE scan|Passive BLE scan mode switched|Starting passive BLE scan' | tail -n 30 || true; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BROAD to BACKGROUND_FILTERED'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -q 'Switching passive BLE scan from BACKGROUND_FILTERED to BROAD'; echo "$LOGS" | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|OutOfMemoryError|SQLiteException|SecurityException' && { echo APP_FATAL_DETECTED >&2; exit 44; } || true; echo PHASE3_FIXED_SCREENOFF_ACCEPTANCE_PASS
